verdict.rationale: Foreloop lets you monitor in-progress agent work (a dashboard row per worker showing task and last message) and approve/reject at gates from your phone, and agents run locally in your own editor/terminal checkout, but there is no documented mechanism for a human to actively take over, pause, or redirect an agent's in-progress task mid-execution from editor, terminal, or browser — approval is described as the only gate, not a takeover/handoff flow. Missing for 10: explicit take-over/redirect UI or command, evidence of pausing an agent and resuming manually, and any browser-based live editing of an in-progress task.
